meta.name: parish-correct-event
meta.description: Correct an event (an "aktualita") already on the new farakurim.cz site - fix its text, date, time, place, programme or links through a corrected record with pnpm replace-event, or stage a corrected or added poster or attachment with --corrected, or make another attachment its poster (or remove it) with pnpm event-poster, then publish. Use whenever the user says an event ("aktualita") is wrong or has changed (new time or place), brings a corrected poster or invitation ("plakát", "pozvánka"), wants to add a file to an event already there, or says its poster is the wrong file or should go. A cancelled or postponed event, or a dropped meeting of a series, is handled by parish-cancel-event, a new event is added with parish-create-event, the pin is moved with parish-pin-event.
